Assignment: Module 8 (Linguistic Markup)

Overview: In this assignment, you will parse a 20-word excerpt of your primary manuscript witness across three distinct tiers: (1) manual grammatical and lexical parse using an authoritative dictionary; (2) deterministic NLP tagging with SpaCy or TreeTagger; and (3) prompt-engineered AI parsing in VS Code. You will execute a three-way comparative diff, record error classifications in LINGUISTIC_AUDIT.md, merge the best readings into linguistic_merged.xml, and synthesize your validated TEI linguistic XML deliverable (transcription_linguistic.xml) using <w> elements with lemma=, pos=, and @resp attributes.

Deadline: due Friday, October 30, by 11:00 PM.
